decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no balustrades or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof of the extension(s). No roof of any part of the extension(s) shall be used for any recreational purpose and access shall only be for the purposes of the maintenance of the property or means of emergency escape. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:LOCATION PLAN N.A/8LA/110EXISTING BLOCK PLAN N.A/8LA/108 APROPOSED BLOCK PLAN N.A/8LA/109 AEXISTING AND PROPOSED PLANS N.A/8LA/101 AEXISTING AND PROPOSED PLANS N.A/8LA/102 AEXISTING AND PROPOSED ROOF PLANS N.A/8LA/103 AEXISTING SECTION X-X N.A/8LA/106 AEXISTING AND PROPOSED ELEVATIONS N.A/8LA/104 BEXISTING AND PROPOSED ELEVATIONS N.A/8LA/105 BPROPOSED SECTION X-X N.A/8LA/107 BDESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT 07-05-2026SuDS ProformaFLOOD RISK ASSESSMENT 26/06/2026Flood Map for Planning Fire Safety StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Prior to the commencement of above-ground works, details demonstrating the provision of no less than 3m3 of level-for-level compensatory flood storage (or such other volume as calculated in accordance with the Council's SFRA methodology) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include a volume calculation and a plan showing the location and method by which the storage is achieved. The approved scheme shall be carried out prior to first use of the extension and retained thereafter.Reason:  To ensure that adequate compensatory flood storage is provided and that the development does not increase flood risk on the site or elsewhere in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF.
